decisions.reason: The candidate already has a message-184 MODIFY covering the new fiat-buyer FAQ, confirmation-email details, dashboard access, automatic reward collection, and email notifications.
The message-184 INTRODUCE already records wallet provisioning, emailed purchase details, dashboard or SIWE reward access, wallet-held rewards, and cash-out guidance.
The candidate's message-184 INTRODUCE already records read-only PDF.js access from the dashboard and email certificate link; the exact email CTA remains an email-delivery attribute.
The candidate already has message-184 MODIFY and RESUME Events establishing automatic transfer to the winner wallet and removing the obsolete claim interaction.
The candidate's message-184 MODIFY already records that Transak converts fiat and directly mints the NFT to the buyer; email contents do not further change the fiat-mint flow.
Message 184 requests email and FAQ changes, not changes to the About page content.
The source discusses referred purchases and fiat-buyer reward access but does not change allocation when no referral code is supplied.
The statement that referrals provide current-draw tickets tied to the NFT or wallet is consistent with the existing ticket lifecycle and changes no issuance, eligibility, reset, or transfer rule.
The source repeats the $15 mint and $5 referral commission but does not change any primary-mint allocation rule.
Emailing NFT details and stating that tickets are tied to an NFT or wallet does not change which referral, ticket-counter, or badge attributes must be visible in NFT metadata.
The source does not mention Aave, prize-pool deposits, or whether the yield integration remains required.
The source's description of on-chain draws using fair randomness is consistent with the existing winner-selection requirement and introduces no changed selection method, eligibility, or provider.
